messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222.
An overdose can be fatal.
This is especially true in a child or other person using the medicine without a prescription.
Overdose symptoms may include severe drowsiness, pinpoint pupils, slow breathing, or no breathing.
Your doctor may recommend you get naloxone.
Naloxone is a medicine to reverse an opioid overdose.
You should keep naloxone with you at all times.
A person caring for you can give naloxone if you stop breathing or don't wake up.
Your caregiver must still get emergency medical help.
Your caregiver may need to perform CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) on you while waiting for help to arrive.
Anyone can buy naloxone from a pharmacy or local health department.
Make sure any person caring for you knows where you keep naloxone and how to use it.
Triplet: ["Naloxone", "has availability information", "can be bought from pharmacy or local health department"]

The relation 'has availability information' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug can be obtained or accessed in the manner described by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'available by': The subject drug is obtainable through the method or requirement specified by the object entity.
B. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'may have added': The subject drug may have the substance specified by the object entity added to it.
D. 'administered via': The subject drug is given through the route of administration specified by the object entity.
E. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the effect specified by the object entity.
